text:
maria: Quick heads-up — I'm drafting the internal RN for release v2.3.0. Rolling out Wed 09:00 PT. A few callouts: model quantization change, dispatcher hotfix, and new batching defaults. Need pin guidance and a short ops blurb.
sam: Thanks — can you paste the short RN snippet here? I'll wire the deploybot cues.
maria: Sure. Snippet:
```text
- model-serving: bump to model-serving:v2.3 (quantized)
- runtime: dispatcher hotfix (fixes session leak)
- defaults: batching window reduced to 8ms
```
devon: For pins — ops prefers pinning model-serving:v2.3 on dedicated pools, unpin after 24h if stable. Canary at 5% for 2h, then 25% for 1h, then full.
sam: Ops blurb (short): "Canary rollout starts 09:00 PT Wed. Oncall: @elaine. Failback: rollback to model-serving:v2.2. Immediate alert if error rate > 2% or p99 latency spike > 200ms." ok?
elaine: LGTM. I'll be on watch. Re rollback criteria add: memory growth > 10% sustained for 5m.
maria: Deploybot run will be: 
```bash
/deploy release v2.3 --pin model-serving:v2.3 --canary 5%:2h,25%:1h --oncall @elaine
```
deploy-bot: deploy queued by sam for release v2.3 — ETA Wed 09:00 PT. Runs require :thumbsup: from eng-releases channel owners.
sam: giving :thumbsup:. Pinning note for RN: "Pinned to dedicated GPU pools during canary. Automatic unpin after confirmation window."
maria: I'll fold these into the RN and post final internal blurb by EOD PST. If anyone wants wording tweaks ping me.
devon: Quick callout — update the console dashboard snippet to include per-model latency. Otherwise good.
maria: noted. thanks all :heart:
